items.detail: The WTA Ningbo final preview labels the start Saturday 24 October while also giving 17:00 local/05:00 ET; the official tournament page dates the final Sunday 25 October. The fixture uses Sunday and preserves the not-before time; the contradiction is not hidden.
items.needs: A corrected WTA article or order of play with an internally consistent day and date.

items.detail: Three finals have comparable official evidence and OLBG rows, so only three picks qualify rather than five. All start labels are not-before times following doubles or ceremonies, not exact beginning times.
items.needs: Two more officially confirmed, OLBG-backed matches and final orders of play for exact starts.

items.detail: Piacenza–Modena and Milano–Cuneo are official Lega Volley fixtures but were absent from the captured OLBG board. Their research lines remain on the lines page without picks; the other four Italian fixtures supply four OLBG-backed selections, not a padded five.
items.needs: Corresponding OLBG event rows before either official-only fixture can receive a pick; a fifth supported match for the target.

items.detail: Italian fixtures now have official calendar and one-round standings support. Listings from other countries remain unpriced until their own league fixture and statistics pages are read.
items.needs: Official sources for the remaining listed leagues.

items.detail: Five Sunday fixtures across the LNH and HBL have official statistics and matching OLBG rows, meeting the five-pick target. The other captured handball listings remain unpriced until their own league or federation sources are read.
items.needs: Official sources for ASOBAL, EHF, Swedish, Danish and international listings.

items.detail: Complete current records for the six Sunday HBL teams came from officially indexed standings rows and the official matchday preview. The direct standings route presented reCAPTCHA; no challenge was bypassed and the official link remains available for manual review.
items.needs: Nothing for these six teams; the access limitation is recorded for reviewers.

items.detail: Three current or upcoming PDC match listings have official schedule, ranking and tournament-leg support, producing three picks. The two outright listings are not matches, and the two Saturday evening matches already underway at the refreshed capture were removed rather than used to pad the target.
items.needs: Two more supported, OLBG-backed match events for the five-match target.

items.detail: PDC confirms the Saturday evening session and match order, while the exact 19:15Z and 20:15Z starts come from OLBG's display and are labelled as such. Sunday's 12:00Z value agrees with the official quarterfinal session start after the clock change.
items.needs: Official per-match scheduled times if exact rather than session-level chronology is required.

items.detail: The official PDC bracket and Sunday session are linked, but its directly readable Saturday report and hub index still exposed pre-match/TBC content. ESPN and The Independent independently confirm Price 10-4 Menzies, Bunting 10-3 Huybrechts and the resulting Sunday quarterfinal. The pairing is not inferred from an unfinished bracket.
items.needs: An updated PDC result report carrying the same afternoon scores for a single-source official audit.

items.detail: Wilson beat Craigie 6-5, but Williams–Jones was live and the other finalist was unknown when read. No future final matchup or price is invented from a live bracket.
items.needs: A completed semifinal and an official final schedule.

items.detail: Four club matches were listed, but no county-board fixture page was read.
items.needs: County-board fixture pages with throw-in times.

items.detail: Official timetable, 17 race results, season standings and all 22 Practice 2 starters support winner and podium prices. Qualifying had not produced a grid, so no starting-position advantage is used. One race supplies one pick, not a padded five.
items.needs: The official qualifying result and grid before any grid-dependent claim; four more supported events for the five-event target.

items.detail: One official baseball fixture exists. The five-per-sport target cannot be met from one scheduled game without inventing matches.
items.needs: More officially scheduled games.

items.detail: Anaheim at Philadelphia started at 17:00Z, before the 18:25Z selection cut-off. It remains in the match list without a pick; its live score is not used.
items.needs: Nothing; recorded for completeness.

items.detail: The Dean Wade row crosses a PDF page break with ambiguous team attribution. It is excluded from every preview and availability input.

items.detail: Current NBA scoring samples contain only one or two games per team. They receive ten league-average games of shrinkage and are not described as established scoring form.

items.detail: NHL standings and team-summary goal-against totals can differ because of shootout accounting. All scoring prices use the team-summary feed consistently instead of mixing conventions.
items.needs: Nothing; the convention is documented.

items.detail: OLBG displayed times are stored verbatim and never treated as UTC. Official league startTimeUTC controls the fixture chronology.
items.needs: Nothing; recorded so the column is not misread.

items.detail: 107 listing rows are published across the 15 hubs. Hubs have a Load More Tips control, so this is not a complete inventory of every OLBG event.
items.needs: Paged reads of every hub to complete the inventory.

items.detail: 387 prices cover moneylines plus NHL puck lines/totals, NBA spreads/totals, MLB run lines/totals, tennis and volleyball set markets, three-way handball result/handicap/total markets, darts match/leg-handicap/total-legs markets, and Formula 1 winner/podium markets. Official-only fixtures may be priced but are not picked without an OLBG row.
items.needs: Official inputs for the remaining sports; no blank is backfilled from OLBG consensus.

items.detail: High is 70% or better. −250 implies 71.43%, so the overlap is only 70.00–71.43%. Cleveland Cavaliers, Denver Nuggets, San Antonio Spurs, Edmonton Oilers, Paris Saint-Germain Handball, Füchse Berlin, New Jersey Devils grade High but price outside the floor; their fair prices are unchanged.
items.needs: No repricing; readers should use the band label alongside the grade.
